items.title: Florian J. "Curly" Lizana Interview, 1966-05-18
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] Levy. Oh, Levy? Leviton. Leviton, that's right.

ctx.x: And it says on the back, the XANA director, Tuva Gerard Levison, is that his name? Who?
Levy. Oh, Levy? Leviton. Leviton, that's right.
